ISO 22301 BCM Platform

Enterprise Business Continuity Management Platform

Next-Generation BCM Solution with AI-Powered Intelligence

Transform your organization’s resilience with our comprehensive Business Continuity Management platform, built on ISO 22301:2019 standards and enhanced with advanced artificial intelligence capabilities.

Platform Overview

The BCM Platform represents a paradigm shift in organizational resilience management. By combining traditional BCM methodologies with cutting-edge AI technology, we deliver a solution that not only responds to disruptions but anticipates and prevents them.

Key Value Propositions

Regulatory Compliance Full alignment with ISO 22301:2019 requirements, automated compliance tracking, and real-time gap analysis ensure your organization meets international standards.

Intelligent Automation AI-driven processes reduce manual workload by 70%, enabling your team to focus on strategic decision-making rather than routine tasks.

Predictive Analytics Advanced machine learning algorithms analyze patterns across your organization to predict potential disruptions before they occur.

Unified Management Single platform for all BCM activities - from risk assessment to incident response, eliminating silos and improving coordination.

Technology Foundation

Microservices Architecture

37 specialized services working in harmony to deliver seamless functionality, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability.

Event-Driven Design

Real-time event processing enables immediate response to changes, ensuring your BCM system is always current and responsive.

Multi-Tenant Platform

Secure isolation between organizations while maintaining operational efficiency, perfect for enterprise deployments and service providers.

Cloud-Native Infrastructure

Built for modern cloud environments with containerization, orchestration, and auto-scaling capabilities.

AI Intelligence Layer

Digital BCM Organism

Our unique approach treats BCM as a living system with 10 specialized AI “organs” that work together to maintain organizational health:

  • Governance Brain: Strategic decision support and policy optimization
  • Risk Advisor: Continuous risk assessment and mitigation recommendations
  • Incident Commander: Automated incident response coordination
  • Recovery Planner: Dynamic recovery strategy optimization
  • Audit Inspector: Continuous compliance monitoring
  • Training Mentor: Personalized learning and skill development
  • Communication Hub: Stakeholder engagement and notification
  • Resource Manager: Optimal resource allocation
  • Performance Monitor: KPI tracking and analysis
  • Knowledge Keeper: Organizational memory and best practices
